No orders will be fulfilled. 0 --> 0 --> DigiTech DOD Overdrive Preamp 250 Pedal - 50th Anniversary Edition Made in USA Be the first to review this product $119.99 Out of stock SKU DIG-DOD25050TH 50th Anniversary Overdrive Pedal Skip to the end of the images gallery Skip to the beginning of the images gallery Details The Overdrive Preamp 250 – 50th Anniversary Edition pedal celebrates the introduction of the original 250 pedal in 1974. Widely considered to be one of the most influential overdrive pedals, the original 250 helped shape the sound of rock and metal in the late ‘70s and early ‘80s. The Overdrive Preamp 250 – 50th Anniversary Edition pedal is hand-built in the USA using the authentic design of the original pedal, while adding two extra modes for modern sonic versatility. The Overdrive Preamp 250 – 50th Anniversary Edition is actually three overdrive pedals in one. Set it to Silicon mode for a faithful reproduction of the original 250’s bite and grind, courtesy of an authentic LM741 op-amp. Select Ge/ASYM mode to engage a Germanium diode for asymmetrical even-order clipping that provides a distinct tonal character with incredible touch response. Or switch to Lift mode to remove diode clipping completely from the signal path, for use as a clean boost and preamp. Complete with a commemorative 50th Anniversary badge, custom artwork and color-matched LED, and a 50th Anniversary pedal topper, the Overdrive Preamp 250 – 50th Anniversary Edition pedal is ideal for players and collectors alike. 50th Anniversary Limited Edition Hand-built — only 1,974 units will be made! 3 Overdrives in One Switch between vintage-authentic SILICON clipping, Ge/ASYM Germanium asymmetrical clipping, or LIFT for no diode clipping for either clean boost use or op-amp rail clipping at higher levels. Mod-Friendly Components Equipped with a socketed LM741 op-amp and through-hole components for easier modding just as the original 250 were known for. For Players and Collectors Alike Whether you’re hitting the stage or simply celebrating a history-making overdrive pedal, you won’t be disappointed. 50 Years of DOD Celebrating the 50th Anniversary of the renowned DOD Electronics, founded in 1974 in Salt Lake City, Utah, USA by entrepreneurs John Johnson and “Mr. DOD” himself, David O. DiFrancesco, we are excited and proud to commemorate this historic anniversary with a limited edition 250 Overdrive/Preamp! The Most Versatile 250 Ever From clean boosts and subtle grit to heavy distortion, this is the most versatile and expressive 250 pedal ever made. 3 Modes 3-way toggle switch for traditional SILICON, Ge/ASYM (Germanium Asymmetrical), and LIFT (no diode clipping for use as a clean boost). Ideal For Collectors Includes a custom 50th Anniversary badge, commemorative pedal topper, guitar picks, and stickers, and individually serial-numbered Certificate of Authenticity. Mod-Friendly Design Hand-built with through-hole components for easier modding. Gain Control Control the amount of overdrive, from subtle grit to full distortion. Level Control Match to your amp's volume, or crank it up to boost leads and solos. Bright Led Indicator Great modern addition to a classic design. Features Dimensions : 4.68” (11.88cm) x 2.63” (6.68cm) x 2.25” (5.71cm) / (L x W x H) - (Jack W = 2.92” (7.41cm)) Input : 1/

sources.excerpt: DOD 250 50th Anniversary Edition Overdrive Preamp Effects Pedal | Music Arts Free Delivery on Orders $25+ Rules Apply Search Sign In or Join Stores Shop Lessons Rentals Educators Repairs Deals Back to School Stores Delivery To : United States Home Amplifiers Effects Effects Effects Pedals Distortion Overdrive Effects Pedals Item # 1617859 Model # DOD-250-50TH-U DOD 250 50th Anniversary Edition Overdrive Preamp Effects Pedal Gray/Yellow site7:prod:product:id:site7prodMAIN0543540 0 Reviews Write Review $249.99 Price: 249.99 Add to Cart Delivery In Stock Ready for Delivery Most ground orders placed before 3pm ET ship same‑day and arrive in 2-5 business days Pickup In-Store Choose Store Save to Wishlist 30 Day Returns Product Description Celebrating 50 years of legendary tone with modern versatility. The DOD Electronics Overdrive Preamp 250 50th Anniversary Edition effects pedal marks half a century of innovation in guitar effects. Honoring the iconic design of the original 250 Overdrive/Preamp, this limited-edition pedal delivers the classic tone loved by generations of guitarists while introducing modern functionality for even greater versatility. Handbuilt in the U.S.A. using through-hole components, the 250 50th is a faithful homage to the past with its vintage design, enhanced by a striking metal flake gray finish and neon yellow-green LED. It is a true celebration of DOD's legacy as "America's Pedal." Versatile Overdrive With Three Distinct Modes The DOD 250 50th includes a three-position toggle switch, offering three unique distortion modes to expand your tonal possibilities. The "SILICON" mode faithfully replicates the original overdrive sound of the 250, while the "Ge/ASYM" mode introduces asymmetrical harmonic distortion using vintage Germanium diodes for a warmer, more dynamic response. The "LIFT" mode removes diode clipping altogether, turning the pedal into a clean or dirty boost depending on the gain setting. These new modes make the DOD 250 50th the most versatile version of the classic overdrive to date. Modern Enhancements, Vintage Appeal While the DOD 250 50th maintains the simple Gain and Level controls that made the original famous, it introduces modern features, such as true-bypass switching and a neon yellow-green LED indicator. The lighter aluminum chassis provides durability while keeping the pedal portable for gigging musicians. Additionally, the socketed LM741 op-amp allows for easy modifications and replacements, providing more flexibility for tone tinkerers. The pedal's aesthetic pays tribute to the vintage gray and yellow color scheme of the original, making it both a collector's item and a reliable tool for today's players. Limited-Edition Design for Collectors and Players This 50th anniversary edition comes with several exclusive accessories, including a custom laser-etched aluminum pedal topper, four unique stickers and four unique guitar picks. The pedal is adorned with a commemorative etched aluminum badge, cementing its status as an instant collector's item. With only a limited number of 1,974 units available, the 250 50th is not only a must-have for tone aficionados, but also a valuable addition to any pedal collection. Hand-Built in the U.S.A. With Attention to Detail Each 250 50th pedal is hand-built in the U.S.A. using high-quality, through-hole components to ensure the best possible sound and durability. The pedal operates on a standard 9V power supply or battery (sold separately), and offers a low power consumption of just 7 mA. With a compact footprint and rugged design, this pedal is perfect for both studio work and live performances. Backed by DOD's 1-year warranty, the 50th anniversary edition is built to last, both as a piece of history and a versatile overdrive pedal for the modern guitarist.
